decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme C0.2/C2 R1; instrument E1/E2; claim ceiling 'nominated'). One flight, one Solver visit per row, seven arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-c1 .. r1-c5 (hand-written candidates), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). Each arm's RAW first answer is read through the E2 reader (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_solver_column_read.py): node-local primary = raw first-answer entity exact-set per row, paired per row against lock, with the whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95 (10,000 draws, seed 20260915) and the paired Wilson share of the discordant rows; secondaries parse_valid, empty_gold_false_fill, nonempty_exact and per-slot-type counts. Each arm's column is also rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded); official contrasts are paired ROW bootstraps (cluster key sample_id, the stage3_paired_read constraint for column arms, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the whole-utterance number beside. (1) THE TWIN NULL: aa minus lock on every metric; the bar = |aa - lock offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant until this cell measures its own null). (2) THE CONTRAST per candidate X: NOMINATED iff (a) the node-local exact-set CI95 lower bound > 0, AND (b) no secondary loss (parse_valid or nonempty_exact lower, or empty_gold_false_fill higher, with a CI95 excluding zero), AND (c) the intent guard holds: rows whose official intent correctness differs from lock <= 7 (0.65 pp of 1,080) or the official intent delta CI95 contains zero, AND (d) the official pooled SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin's SLU bar. HARM iff (a') the exact-set CI95 upper bound < 0. Among several NOMINATED arms the best node-local point estimate wins (ties: fewer words). PLATEAU RULE (programme C0.4): two evaluated rounds without a NOMINATED arm lock the delivering template and close the node. A nomination is confirmed once on TRAIN Fold A as a two-arm column before any lock; it admits nothing by itself. The delivering lock arm's own offline post-processing columns v4 and v4g are read beside (analysis recipe, offline_columns).
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold B development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: the Solver instruction template (phase_material.solver.instruction_template) of each non-delivering arm: ONE hash-pinned path per arm under probes/nx/solver/r1/, nothing else (no supply knob, decoding, response format or tool authority); the base, the Fold B pins, the review-off program and the module block are the instrument's carrier, shared by every arm
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact or read (Fold A confirms only a later two-arm column, under its own registration).
No second factor: one axis (the Solver instruction template), none on aa or lock.
No tool schema on any role; no Reviewer or Planner visit; max_revisions 0.
No v4 or v4g normaliser wired into the cell: the runtime delivery normaliser is the COMP-1b module cell's (v3); v4 and v4g are OFFLINE read columns only.
No flight before root countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No arm score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a column effect may only nominate.
